routing.task_class: Independent Codex parent-session creation, addressing, coordination, relay, review, and lifecycle control
natural_language_triggers: 親セッション同士を連携
routing.primary_route: Use $control-codex-sessions with the codex_session_control_plane MCP tools; plan in dry-run, preview dispatch, then create or steer App Server threads only from explicit live authorization.
fallback_conditions: Use read-only Codex App Server inspection when the MCP server is not exposed but the source and generated protocol schema are available.
Return a dry-run topology and exact blocked capability when App Server authentication or model discovery is unavailable.
non_use_conditions: Do not use for ordinary official subagent delegation within one Codex thread.
Do not create, steer, interrupt, or archive live sessions without explicit current-task authorization.
Do not use plugin cache, App Server logs, or the runtime ledger as editable source.

trigger_phrases: 親セッション同士を連携

interface.short_description: Coordinate independent Codex parent sessions safely
interface.default_prompt: Use $control-codex-sessions to create a dry-run upper-control plan for independent Codex sessions.

tools.description: Persistent App Server session control, relay, review, and dashboard tools

inputs.name: control objective
inputs.description: Concrete whole-run outcome owned by the controller.

inputs.name: bounded task assignments
inputs.description: Per-task title, prompt, role, absolute project cwd, model, reasoning effort, sandbox, and acceptance boundary.

inputs.name: controller address
inputs.description: Optional controller thread ID and host ID retained for reciprocal addressing.

inputs.name: live authorization
inputs.description: Explicit current-task authorization required for real session creation, turns, interruption, relay, and archival.

outputs.name: control ledger
outputs.description: Atomic JSON state containing runs, tasks, sessions, correlated envelopes, events, results, artifacts, and verification.

outputs.name: session addresses
outputs.description: App Server thread IDs and turn IDs bound to task roles and execution profiles.

outputs.name: controller decisions
outputs.description: Auditable accept, reject, fail, stop, relay, and archive outcomes.

outputs.name: loopback dashboard
outputs.description: Local operational view with Japanese/English/System language and Light/Dark/System theme controls.

forbidden_source_paths: Codex session JSONL and runtime logs

user_facing_ui.display_verification: Run node --test tests/ui-contract.test.mjs, then inspect the localhost dashboard in the in-app Browser.

rules.description: Real thread creation, follow-up turns, cross-session relay, interruption, and archival require live mode plus an explicit confirmation flag.
Only valid state transitions and a controller review decision can complete a task or the global run.
Inter-session messages retain run, task, sender thread, recipient thread, type, hop, artifact, and verification provenance.
Every controlled session and turn binds the declared project cwd, model, reasoning effort, approval policy, and sandbox through current App Server methods.
Control state writes serialize updates and persist by temporary file, fsync, and atomic rename with private file permissions.
The dashboard binds only to loopback, denies untrusted action requests, applies a restrictive content security policy, and limits request bodies.
The operational dashboard provides persistent Japanese, English, and System language selection plus Light, Dark, and System theme selection.
